items.title: Lemon Nash Interview, 1960-09-28
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Do you want to record one of them, Forrest?

ctx.x: Yeah, they just sing all them old side songs.
Do you want to record one of them, Forrest? I might get one of them.
I might get one of them. Yeah, I know the fellow who sang that sad song on the railroad about my home in Boston City Boys. Home in Boston City Boys.
